chapter: Returning to the US and the Savoy band
title: Return to the United States and forming a band
summary: Returning in 1938 to busy bands and 52nd Street, he planned a band immediately.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And then you went back to the States. What did you find on your return? What was the atmosphere? Do you recall your impressions of that time?
Well, it was very, very busy. The bands were doing well. I think Goodman and the Dorseys were riding high.
Miller was coming in to prominence. Fifty-second street was jumping.
There was a lot of activity.
You jumped right in to everything.
Well, actually, I guess the first thing I did ...
Did you start playing with others? Did you plan immediately to form a band?
Yes, I guess I did plan immediately to form a band, because I didn't play with anyone; I don't remember playing with any one at that time, you know.
I got a band together and I don't remember whether I got the band together first or whether I had the opportunity to go in to the Savoy first, or what. When did I go in to the Savoy?
Wasn't that early 1939? Pretty early in 1939.
Well, I came back in '38. Now I'm trying to recall what I did between that time and when I went in to the Savoy with the band.
